name: @corbits-builder/writer-plugin
description: Writes the project's documents, has them reviewed and puts them in front of the person to approve.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project's documents need writing or revising, a second opinion, or the person's approval.
builder.unless: The person wants the app itself changed, or only a mockup.

write-requirements.when: The project needs its product requirements written, or revised with what the person said.
write-requirements.unless: The person wants the app itself changed, or only a mockup.

write-build-plan.when: The project needs a build plan, or its plan revised: the stack, the phases of work and the checks.
write-build-plan.unless: What the app must do is still being settled with the person.

review.when: You want a second opinion on a filed document before you rely on it or put it to the person.
review.unless: The person asked for something you can start directly.

approve.summary: Puts filed documents in front of the person to approve, each at its current version. Only the person's answer on the approval card records an approval, so it is started with its own tool, request_approval({ kinds }), and never with execute.
approve.when: Filed documents are ready for the person to approve, with no open questions left.
approve.unless: The person chose to let you decide approvals, or the work is a change to an app that already exists.

examples: write up what the app should do
add offline mode to the requirements
I want to plan an app for my team
use Postgres in the plan instead
show me what I need to sign off
